notes: Three fixes the input-disclosure strip exposed on its first real reading. One of them corrects a claim I made twice and got wrong. The opex "double subtraction" was not a double subtraction I said in two consecutive turns that opex_pct = gm − ebit − D&A double-counts, and called it "arithmetic, not opinion." It isn't. company-model.js:160 reads: js const opex = revenue * (at('opex_pct') / 100); // cash opex (calibration excludes D&A) The exclusion is deliberate — opex_pct is *cash* opex so the projection can model D&A off the asset base rather than as a revenue ratio, and line 161 adds it back
